# Install the 3 pm-skills v2 gap skills (pm-ai-shipping + strategy-red-team) to tri-end.
param([switch]$Force)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Write-Utf8NoBom.ps1')

$cursorSkills = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cursor\skills'
$claudeSkills = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.claude\skills'
$codexSkills = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.codex\skills'

function Remove-LinkOrDir {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return }
    $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force
    if ($item.LinkType -in @('Junction', 'SymbolicLink')) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force }
    elseif ($item.PSIsContainer) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Recurse -Force }
    else { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force }
}

function Install-SkillDir {
    param([string]$Name, [string]$Content)
    $dest = Join-Path $cursorSkills $Name
    if ((Test-Path $dest) -and -not $Force) {
        Write-Host "SKIP exists: $Name"
        return 'skipped'
    }
    Remove-LinkOrDir -Path $dest
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path (Join-Path $dest 'SKILL.md') -Content $Content
    Write-Host "INSTALLED: $Name"
    foreach ($root in @($claudeSkills, $codexSkills)) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $root)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root -Force | Out-Null }
        $link = Join-Path $root $Name
        Remove-LinkOrDir -Path $link
        New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $link -Target $dest | Out-Null
        Write-Host "  junction -> $root\$Name"
    }
    return 'installed'
}

$skills = @{
    'shipping-artifacts' = @'
---
name: shipping-artifacts
description: "The durable documentation set that makes an AI-built (vibe-coded) app reviewable before shipping. A small core every app needs — architecture, user/permission flows, permissions, variables/secrets, and a test-coverage map — plus conditional docs added only when they apply: emails, scheduled work, SEO, and embedded agents/automation. Defines what each doc must capture and how a reviewer or auditor uses it. Use when documenting a codebase for handoff, mapping user journeys and trust-boundary crossings, planning test coverage, or preparing for a security or performance audit."
disable-model-invocation: true
---
# Shipping Artifacts: The Docs That Make AI-Built Code Reviewable

See upstream: https://github.com/phuryn/pm-skills/tree/main/pm-ai-shipping/skills/shipping-artifacts
'@

    'intended-vs-implemented' = @'
---
name: intended-vs-implemented
description: "The method for finding the gap between what a system is supposed to do and what the code actually does — the class of bug generic scanners miss because they have no model of intent. Defines what counts as documented intent, what counts as implementation evidence, which mismatches matter, and how to avoid hand-wavy findings. Use when auditing AI-built code, reviewing access control against documented permissions, or checking whether a codebase matches its own documentation."
disable-model-invocation: true
---
# Intended vs. Implemented: Auditing the Gap

See upstream: https://github.com/phuryn/pm-skills/tree/main/pm-ai-shipping/skills/intended-vs-implemented
'@

    'strategy-red-team' = @'
---
name: strategy-red-team
description: "Red-team a PRD, roadmap, or strategy by attacking its load-bearing assumptions before reality does. Steelmans then attacks each claim, ranks failure modes by impact × likelihood × cheapness-to-test, and returns the cheapest test and kill criteria for each. Use when stress-testing a plan, pressure-testing a strategy, challenging assumptions, or preparing a doc for executive review."
disable-model-invocation: true
---
# Strategy Red-Team: Attack the Assumptions Before Reality Does

See upstream: https://github.com/phuryn/pm-skills/tree/main/pm-execution/skills/strategy-red-team
'@
}

$installed = @()
foreach ($kv in $skills.GetEnumerator()) {
    if ((Install-SkillDir -Name $kv.Key -Content $kv.Value) -eq 'installed') {
        $installed += $kv.Key
    }
}

$scan = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'scan-global-skills.ps1'
if (Test-Path $scan) { & $scan -OutputFormat Plain | Out-Null }
Write-Host "Gap install done. New: $($installed -join ', ')"

function RemoveLink([string]$p){ if(-not(Test-Path $p)){return}; $i=Get-Item $p -Force; if($i.LinkType){Remove-Item $p -Force}else{Remove-Item $p -Recurse -Force} }
function MirrorCodex([string]$name){
  $src=(Resolve-Path (Join-Path $cursor $name)).Path
  if(-not(Test-Path $codex)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $codex -Force | Out-Null }
  $link=Join-Path $codex $name
  RemoveLink $link
  New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $link -Target $src -Force | Out-Null
  Write-Host "Codex junction: $name"
}
$pmSkills=@(
  @{Name='shipping-artifacts'; Url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phuryn/pm-skills/main/pm-ai-shipping/skills/shipping-artifacts/SKILL.md'},
  @{Name='intended-vs-implemented'; Url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phuryn/pm-skills/main/pm-ai-shipping/skills/intended-vs-implemented/SKILL.md'},
  @{Name='strategy-red-team'; Url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phuryn/pm-skills/main/pm-execution/skills/strategy-red-team/SKILL.md'}
)
foreach($s in $pmSkills){
  $dir=Join-Path $cursor $s.Name
  if(-not(Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $s.Url -OutFile (Join-Path $dir 'SKILL.md') -UseBasicParsing
  MirrorCodex $s.Name
  Write-Host "Installed $($s.Name)"
}
$l30src=Join-Path $vendor 'skills\last30days'
if(Test-Path $l30src){
  $l30dest=Join-Path $cursor 'last30days'
  RemoveLink $l30dest
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $l30src -Destination $l30dest -Recurse -Force
  MirrorCodex 'last30days'
  Write-Host 'Installed last30days'
}

& powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:USERPROFILE\.ai-workspace\scripts\scan-global-skills.ps1" -OutputFormat Plain | Out-Null
